title: Composed supervisory control: Toggle output on qualified rising edge -> Voted permissive with qualified bypass and diagnostics

outputs.name: A_AcceptedPulse
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Qualified edge accepted this scan

outputs.name: B_Degraded
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Run uses disagreement or bypass

outputs.name: B_Blocked
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Selected request cannot run

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear A_State and suppress A_AcceptedPulse with highest priority.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A rising A_Button edge while A_Enable is TRUE shall invert A_State exactly once.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Holding A_Button TRUE shall not repeatedly toggle A_State.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: The selected request shall be B_AutoRequest in automatic mode and B_ManualRequest otherwise.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Without bypass, B_RunPermit requires B_SafetyOK and at least two TRUE channels.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_RunPermit AND !B_BypassActive) -> (B_SafetyOK AND vote2of3)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Bypass may latch only in manual mode when B_BypassRequest, B_BypassPermit, B_SafetyOK, and at least one channel are TRUE.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (rose(B_BypassActive) -> (!B_AutoMode AND B_BypassRequest AND B_BypassPermit AND B_SafetyOK AND any_channel)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset may clear B_BypassActive only when neither automatic nor manual request is active.

While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Degraded shall identify a permitted run with channel disagreement or active bypass; B_Blocked shall identify a selected request without B_RunPermit.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Degraded = (B_RunPermit AND ((!unanimous_channels) OR B_BypassActive)))) AND G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Blocked = (selected_request AND !B_RunPermit)))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_State shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_RunPermit AND NOT B_Degraded AND NOT B_BypassActive AND NOT B_Blocked)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_RunPermit AND NOT B_Degraded AND NOT B_BypassActive AND NOT B_Blocked))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

composition.runtime_design: one stateful primary subsystem plus one stateless Boolean subsystem

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
